name: The White Cube
detailed_description:
Step into an art gallery where reality and illusion intertwine. As the night security guard, you will:

  • Investigate a Mysterious Art Exhibit: Explore an enigmatic collection where artworks conceal truths long forgotten

  • Uncover the Secrets of "The Cube": Delve into the dark legacy surrounding "The Cube," a central piece shrouded in mystery.

  • Navigate a Liminal Space: Experience a gallery designed according to the "white cube" aesthetic, emphasizing the artworks and creating an atmosphere reminiscent of liminal spaces

  • Meet the Resident Cat: Your furry companion can sense things hidden to the human eye - will you let it guide you?

Key Features

  • First-Person Exploration: Navigate the gallery's minimalist halls, each room offering unique challenges and revelations.

  • Evolving Artworks: Witness art pieces that react to your presence, altering the gallery's atmosphere and narrative.

  • Atmospheric Sound Design: Immerse yourself in an evocative auditory experience that enhances the gallery's enigmatic ambiance.

  • Narrative Discovery: Piece together the story of the artist's dark legacy through environmental storytelling and subtle clues.

Prepare for a night of suspense and discovery. Your night shift begins now.
